content:
As Amazon's fall Prime Day event officially kicks off, now is arguably one of the best times to pick up a new pair of AirPods. While Apple's latest AirPods 5 lineup hasn't yet seen a holiday discount, the AirPods Pro 3 have dropped to a price that, for most people, is likely the better value choice; and for those looking to try Apple's over-ear experience, the 2026 AirPods Max 2 are now $120 off across all five colorways.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $179 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (originally $549)

Apple has launched the new entry-level AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation, priced at $129 — which genuinely surprised me. However, if you want the wireless charging case, you'll have to step up to the $149 version, but at that point you're only $30 more than the AirPods Pro for a more advanced, higher-end model — for me, it's a no-brainer.

Originally $249, now $70 off, it's already very close to the all-time low we've tracked on Amazon, just $10 higher — a price we've only seen once on Amazon since the AirPods Pro 3 launched.

In time, the new AirPods 5 will almost certainly drop to around $100 or even lower, but based on past records and experience with the previous generation, it may not fall below $99 until mid-2027. Besides, even if it does reach that price then, the AirPods Pro 3 still offer triple the noise cancellation, longer battery life, a built-in heart rate sensor, the full suite of hearing aid features, and what I think is a better fit.

All of these reasons are already enough to make anyone choose the AirPods Pro 3 over the new 5 series, but if you're after Apple's premium over-ear offering, this fall Prime Day deal on the 2026 Max 2 is the one for you.

The current price is just $30 above the all-time low we've tracked on Amazon, and you can get $120 off on any of the five colorways.

It's worth noting that since its launch earlier this year, this is only the second time we've recorded this price — only once before has it sold for less.

Top brands like Sony and Bose also have solid headphone deals (see the list below), but if you ask me, nothing quite beats a Cupertino-designed personal listening experience. If you're still not entirely sold, there are plenty of safe choices in there, along with a lineup of eye-catching deals across the Apple ecosystem.
